text: Implemented canonical continuous-only normalized separable Lanczos-5 in reframe4s-resample and exposed it through the existing motion application policy. Evidence: independent asymmetric-oblique/impulse oracle, constant and absolute-support validity, low-frequency analytic accuracy, extreme finite coordinate rejection, D3+Time run/scan identity, compile-negative labels, and motion selection pass on JVM/Scala.js; testAll passes 441 tests across 82 current reports; FullOpt Node passes 33 laws and 38 motion tests; isolated JVM scan allocates 464 B at both 64 and 1000 voxels, materializes zero coordinates, records zero peak-heap delta and 0.532045 MVox/s; PRD/build DAG/protocol/symbol validators pass at 27 nodes, 86 edges, 564 public names, 56 owners.
